CustomField.description: Expected number of payments in the active observation window, capped at 12 months, based on NPSP installment period and establishment date.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(npe03__Installment_Period__c), "Monthly", IF( ISBLANK(npe03__Date_Established__c), 12, MIN(12, MAX(1, CEILING((TODAY() - npe03__Date_Established__c + 1) / 30))) ), "Quarterly", IF( ISBLANK(npe03__Date_Established__c), 4, MIN(4, MAX(1, CEILING((TODAY() - npe03__Date_Established__c + 1) / 90))) ), "Annual", 1, "Yearly", 1, 0 )
CustomField.label: Expected Payments 12M
